facts_of_case: Shri Jai Rajan Panikar filed for divorce, which was dismissed. He died during appeal. Anita applied for pensionary and other service benefits. Rita and her children claimed they were his wife and children and sought to restrain Anita from withdrawing the benefits.

legal_principles.principle: The appropriate court for moving an application would be the Trial Court and not this Court.
legal_principles.held: In my opinion, the appropriate Court for moving the said application would be the Trial Court and not this Court.

legal_principles.principle: The children, claimed to be of the deceased Sh. Jai Rajan Panikar, if so proved, were entitled to the benefit of Section 16 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
legal_principles.held: The Addl. District Judge held that since the children, claimed to be of the deceased Sh. Jai Rajan Panikar, if so proved, were entitled to the benefit of Section 16 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955

outcome.final_order: The Air Force was restrained from releasing the pensionary and other benefits to Anita till the question of whether Rita and her children were the deceased's wife and children was decided.

use_for_drafting: advising on family pension and service benefits
representing in appeals against dismissal of divorce petitions
